---
title: "Car Stats Explorer"
---

Find vehicles by manufacturer, model year, and vehicle type, then compare price,
engine horsepower, and highway fuel economy in the table.

## Find and compare cars

```{r}
suppressPackageStartupMessages(library(tidyverse))
suppressPackageStartupMessages(library(crosstalk))
suppressPackageStartupMessages(library(DT))

cars <- read_csv(
  "https://gist.githubusercontent.com/dvinubius/33486dad2dc86319f0a06ffdb1d4f34f/raw/",
  show_col_types = FALSE
) |>
  drop_na(
    Make, Model, Year, MSRP, `Engine HP`, `highway MPG`,
    `Vehicle Size`, `Vehicle Style`
  ) |>
  filter(MSRP > 0, `Engine HP` > 0, `highway MPG` > 0)

car_rows <- cars |>
  transmute(
    car_id = row_number(),
    Make,
    Model,
    Year,
    price = MSRP,
    horsepower = `Engine HP`,
    highway_mpg = as.numeric(`highway MPG`),
    vehicle_type = `Vehicle Style`,
    vehicle_size = `Vehicle Size`
  )

shared_cars <- SharedData$new(
  car_rows,
  key = ~car_id,
  group = "home-car-comparison"
)

bscols(
  widths = c(4, 4, 4),
  filter_select("manufacturer", "Manufacturer", shared_cars, ~Make, multiple = TRUE),
  filter_slider("model_year", "Model year", shared_cars, ~Year, step = 1),
  filter_select(
    "vehicle_type",
    "Vehicle type",
    shared_cars,
    ~vehicle_type,
    multiple = TRUE
  )
)
```

## Compare cars

Sort the table by price, horsepower, or highway MPG to compare specific vehicles.

```{r}
DT::datatable(
  shared_cars,
  rownames = FALSE,
  colnames = c(
    "Row", "Manufacturer", "Model", "Year", "Price (MSRP)",
    "Horsepower (hp)", "Highway MPG", "Vehicle type", "Vehicle size"
  ),
  options = list(
    dom = "tip",
    pageLength = 10,
    scrollX = TRUE,
    columnDefs = list(list(visible = FALSE, targets = 0))
  )
) |>
  DT::formatCurrency("price", "$", digits = 0)
```
